en: Summons 1 portal nearby whenever the allied team deals normal attack damage [[20]] times, up to 4 portals. Every [[3]]s, each portal launches a flying sword at the frontmost enemy, dealing true damage equal to [[5%]] of [[Team ATK]] and increasing the target's damage taken by [[5%]] for [[4]]s, up to [[4]] stacks.
